components.name: lower_weighted_base
components.notes: Low full-footprint weighted base bounded by the published length and width.
evidence: visible lower perimeter seam in both marketplace closed views

components.name: connected_upper_shell
components.notes: U-plan upper shell: paired wave rails, front cutter bridge, rear bridge, and a real central channel.

components.name: attached_hub
components.notes: Hinged radial tape hub shown raised in one reference.

components.name: tape_roll
components.notes: Annular roll nested on the hub and between the rails.

components.name: cutter_blade
components.notes: Thin serrated metal blade spanning the front bridge.

relationships.notes: A continuous side seam separates upper shell from lower base.
Opened-hub image exposes a rear hinge relationship.
Roll core surrounds the radial hub.
Blade spans the front bridge between two raised end caps.

claims.statement: The dominant form is a low rectangular base under a connected wave-shaped U-plan upper shell.
claims.modeling_consequence: Reserve the full dimensions, then author the center valley, rear rise, paired rails, and transverse bridges before detail.

claims.statement: The center between the rails is an open recessed channel, not a dark top panel.
evidence: opened-hub oblique exposes the cavity floor and side boundaries
claims.modeling_consequence: Use a connected U-plan cage with omitted center cells; do not stack two rails on a full-width top primitive.

claims.statement: The two raised rails connect across a transverse rear bridge behind the roll.
claims.modeling_consequence: Build one connected upper shell rather than two disconnected side strips.

claims.statement: Hub, tape roll, and cutter blade have visible assembly/material boundaries and remain independently editable.
claims.modeling_consequence: Use separate radial hub/roll geometry and a separate thin blade; separation is functional rather than primitive spam.
Freeze the complete blockout to these dimensions before judging local perspective proportions.

claims.statement: The housing and radial roll are approximately symmetric across the length-height center plane.
evidence: paired rails and centered roll in opposing obliques
claims.modeling_consequence: Author paired rail widths symmetrically; preserve asymmetry only where the hinge mechanism requires it.

claims.statement: A connected quad-shell grid with omitted center cells best preserves the observed U-plan continuity and channel while remaining editable.
claims.modeling_consequence: Use the generic quad-shell-grid operation for the upper shell, not an object-specific builder or disconnected rail primitives.

claims.statement: Exact hinge pin, cavity floor transitions, serration pitch, and underside construction are not established.
claims.modeling_consequence: Keep these regions reversible and outside the primary blockout acceptance claim.

strategies.name: connected_u_shell_over_separate_base
strategies.representation: one connected all-quad U-plan upper shell over one low base, plus separate functional hub, roll, and blade

strategies.name: full_width_top_with_rail_primitives
strategies.representation: solid full-width top block decorated with two independent curved rail primitives
strategies.rejection_reason: The opened-hub view proves a real center volume and a transverse rear connection; a full-width top would fill the negative space and disconnected rails would break continuity.
